verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਰਾਜ ਤਨੁ ਜੰਬੁਕ ਅਧੀਨ ਹੋਤ ਖਗਪਤਿ ਸੁਤ ਜਾਇ ਜੁਹਾਰਤ ਕਾਗ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise miragaraaj tan ja(n)buk adheen hot khagapat sut jai juhaarat kaag hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a cub becomes subservient to a jackal or a Garud (Ardea argala) bows to a crow.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਹ ਕੇਤ ਬਸ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਨ ਮੈ  ਸੁਰਤਰੁ ਸੋਭ ਨ ਅਰਕ ਬਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise raeh ket bas girahan mai  suratar sobh na arak ban rav sas laag hai ||

en.bdb: Just as Sun and Moon resides in the houses of Rahu and Ketu (the two unfriendly mythological demons), or Kalapbrichh the all giving tree of heavens does not fit into the jungle of Calotropis procera.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਮਧੇਨ ਸੁਤ ਸੂਕਰੀ ਸਥਨ ਪਾਨ ਐਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੁਤ ਗਰਧਭ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise kaamadhen sut sookaree sathan paan aairaapat sut garadhabh agrabhaag hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a calf of ever milk-yielding cow (Kamdhenu) sucks the teats of a she pig, or the young one of Airawat the elephant of god Inder keeps bowing before a donkey.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਤ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਿਉ ਬੰਸ ਮੈ ਬਜਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥੪੭੭॥
verses.translit_en: taise gursikh sut aan dhev sevak hui nihafal janam jiau ba(n)s mai bajaag hai ||477||

en.bdb: Similarly, if son of a Guru's Sikh starts worshipping gods and goddesses, his human birth would be a failure just as a son of two fathers would be in a respectable family.  (477)
